name: Coverage Consumer
summary: Consumes completeness assessments derived from duration and source-health facts.
description: Uses coverage.completeness-assess to distinguish complete, partial, and unavailable coverage from supplied duration and source-health facts. Needs a deterministic completeness signal without inferring more than the supplied coverage boundary supports.

distinguished_from.how: Interprets completeness and availability facts, rather than classifying preservation obligations for assets.
Needs deterministic completeness state for a bounded coverage window, rather than successor revision metadata for immutable artifacts.
